text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Tenno Sho (Spring). The TV 
in the waiting room broadcasts pre-race 
interviews with Mejiro McQueen and Rice 
Shower.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Watching that footage, Mihono Bourbon's 
desire to "win" escalated abnormally. She 
voiced her anxieties, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Reassured by Trainer that those feelings 
would become her strength, her fighting 
spirit for victory flared up with peace of 
mind.
